title: Pontotoc’s FCA 5K starts Saturday at Gateway Pavilion. The Rudolph Run follows Dec. 12
excerpt: The FCA run and walk takes race-day entries at Gateway Pavilion. December’s 5K and 10K start at the county library, with a separate registration deadline.

sources.title: FCA Pontotoc 5K organizer registration and race-day instructions
17th annual Rudolph Run registration and packet pickup
Chamber’s Rudolph Run flyer showing the December date

facts.statement: Runners and walkers can sign up under Pontotoc’s Gateway Pavilion from 6:30 to 7:30 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 21, for the FCA 5K. The race starts at 8 a.m., five minutes after a scheduled start-line prayer. The organizer lists a $40 entry fee and says participants will receive bibs and timing chips.
facts.evidence: Organizer lists cost, race-day pavilion registration window, 7:55 prayer, 8:00 start, bibs and chips. Online cutoff displays vary, so none asserted.
facts.date_context: Local times on Saturday, November 21 and Saturday, December 12, 2026.
facts.identities: FCA Pontotoc 5K; PACT, the Pontotoc County affiliate of CREATE; Gateway Pavilion and Pontotoc County Library.

facts.statement: The 17th annual Rudolph Run is a separate event on Saturday, Dec. 12. Both the 10K run and the 5K walk or run start at 8:30 a.m. at the Pontotoc County Library, 111 North Main Street. The routes pass through downtown and a residential area before returning to the library.
facts.evidence: Organizer lists distances, starts and ends at library, North Main address, business and residential route. Visually verified Chamber flyer clearly reads December 12, 2026 at 8:30 AM.
facts.date_context: Local times on Saturday, November 21 and Saturday, December 12, 2026.
facts.identities: FCA Pontotoc 5K; PACT, the Pontotoc County affiliate of CREATE; Gateway Pavilion and Pontotoc County Library.

facts.statement: PACT, the Pontotoc County affiliate of CREATE, lists a $35 entry fee for the Rudolph Run and a Dec. 1 online registration deadline. Runners can also register at the library from 7 to 8 a.m. on race day for an additional $5. Packet pickup is at the library during that same hour.
facts.evidence: Registration description identifies host, price, Dec 1 online cutoff, race-day $5 surcharge and 7–8 a.m. packet pickup and entries. No conflicting Dec 1 hour asserted.
facts.date_context: Local times on Saturday, November 21 and Saturday, December 12, 2026.
facts.identities: FCA Pontotoc 5K; PACT, the Pontotoc County affiliate of CREATE; Gateway Pavilion and Pontotoc County Library.

paragraphs.text: Runners and walkers can sign up under Pontotoc’s Gateway Pavilion from 6:30 to 7:30 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 21, for the FCA 5K. The race starts at 8 a.m., five minutes after a scheduled start-line prayer. The organizer lists a $40 entry fee and says participants will receive bibs and timing chips.

The 17th annual Rudolph Run is a separate event on Saturday, Dec. 12. Both the 10K run and the 5K walk or run start at 8:30 a.m. at the Pontotoc County Library, 111 North Main Street. The routes pass through downtown and a residential area before returning to the library.

PACT, the Pontotoc County affiliate of CREATE, lists a $35 entry fee for the Rudolph Run and a Dec. 1 online registration deadline. Runners can also register at the library from 7 to 8 a.m. on race day for an additional $5. Packet pickup is at the library during that same hour.
